notes.title: New Trailer!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone! 

We're getting closer to the release of DARKWATCH and we've decided to make a new trailer as there's been some significant changes we've made to the game. 

We hope you enjoy and we look forward to you all playing the game soon!

Thanks for all the support from us here at TimeCrashGames!
